commit_message:
docs(prelaunch): record F011/SCR009 and reconcile the proxy narrative

Promotes the spec draft to docs/vi/features/F011_CountdownPrelaunchPage and
docs/vi/screens/SCR009_CountdownPrelaunch with real path:line citations, so
the feature validator reports zero criticals against it.

The system and generated docs describe the code as built rather than as
drafted. The forward-drafts assumed the lock only walled off routes the
widened matcher newly exposed; as built it preempts the whole legacy
six-route whitelist, so while the flag is on every page route redirects to
/prelaunch. The 303-for-non-GET behaviour is written down too, with the
reason. Two stale claims elsewhere fell out of the same pass: architecture
said src/domain and src/components had no consumers, and permissions said
no feature flag gates access.

Also records the session journal and reconciles the plan and phase files.
The phase-04 curl recipe had been reconciled to the pre-fix behaviour by
mistake; it now carries the measured matrix and an explicit warning about
which behaviour was the bug.
